title: On Blowing the shutters wide open
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：blow　|　正文 349 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 blow 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the wind ① blew the shutters wide open year after year, and every sender in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the wind ② blows the shutters wide open for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ blow the shutters wide open at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ blown the shutters wide open before — a line in the list for June 1962 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Blowing the shutters wide open year after year, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the wind ever ⑥ blows half the tiles off the roof for the whole place before the June rains, nobody in the office would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ blow half the tiles off the roof for the whole place and never speak of it again.

By 1975 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a second wind ⑧ blows half the tiles off the roof year after year every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the office said a word; ⑨ The wind blew the shutters wide open again in 1978, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To blow the shutters wide open, my mother said in 1980, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, the wind blows the shutters wide open for the whole place again and the wind must blow the shutters wide open year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 吹开（一般过去式 blew the shutters wide open：1968 年那阵风头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 吹开（一般现在 blows the shutters wide open：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 吹开（不定式 to blow the shutters wide open：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 吹开（过去完成时 had blown the shutters wide open：1962 年六月的收发清单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 吹开（动名词 blowing the shutters wide open 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 刮走（blows half the tiles off the roof：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真刮走屋顶一半的瓦都被刮走）
G. v. 刮走（blow half the tiles off the roof：let it 之后的原形，指随它去屋顶一半的瓦都被刮走）
H. v. 吹开（后段两处：后来的那阵风照例 blows half the tiles off the roof，而那阵风在 1978 年又一次 blew the shutters wide open）

items.q: to blow the shutters wide open
blown the shutters wide open before
blows half the tiles off the roof for the whole place
blow half the tiles off the roof for the whole place and
blows half the tiles off the roof year after year
blew the shutters wide open again
to blow the shutters wide open

answers.why: blow 意为“吹开”，1968 年那阵风年年地吹开把窗板吹得大开，那是邮局里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 blew。
blow 意为“吹开”，自那以后那阵风替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 blows。
blow 意为“吹开”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯吹开把窗板吹得大开”，此处为不定式 to blow the shutters wide open。
blow 意为“吹开”，收发清单里 六月 那行字说明早在 1975 年之前就有人吹开过，故用过去完成时 had blown。
blow 意为“吹开”，那阵风说“吹开把窗板吹得大开这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 blowing the shutters wide open 作主语。
blow 意为“刮走”，叔叔说的是“万一那阵风真刮走屋顶一半的瓦都被刮走”，if 从句里用一般现在 blows half the tiles off the roof。
blow 意为“刮走”，老手们的规矩是“随它刮走屋顶一半的瓦都被刮走”（let it blow half the tiles off the roof），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
blow 意为“吹开”，后来的那阵风每个星期都照例刮走屋顶一半的瓦都被刮走，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 blows。
blow 意为“吹开”，那阵风在 1978 年在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地吹开把窗板吹得大开，用一般过去式 blew 叙述。
blow 意为“吹开”，结尾那句是母亲 1980 年的话：要吹开把窗板吹得大开，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和邮局记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 blow 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the wind blew the shutters wide open year after year, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the wind blows the shutters wide open for the whole place whenever the office asks.
Blowing the shutters wide open year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If the wind ever blows half the tiles off the roof for the whole place before the June rains, nobody knows what to do next.
A second wind blows half the tiles off the roof year after year every week, asking nothing about the past.
The wind blew the shutters wide open again in 1978, and this time nothing was written down.
